sentences.text:
Devendra Ku. Agrawal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 23
March, 2022

Bench: Virender Singh
 1
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur
 Crr No. 3568 of 2021
 (Devendra Ku. Agrawal Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh 
 Dated : 23-03-2022
 Shri Vijay Nayak, counsel for the petitioner.

entities.text: High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri Ajay Shukla, Public Prosecutor for the respondent No
Heard on I.A. No.4894/2022, which is the second application under Section 397 (1) of Cr.P.C. for
suspension of sentence of the petitioner.
The first application (I.A. No.23230/2021) for suspension of sentence of the petitioner has been dismissed on merits by a detailed and exhaustive order dated 24.02.2022.
There is no substantive change in the facts and circumstances of the case, therefore, I.A. No.4894/2022 stands dismissed.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that while dismissing the first application for suspension of sentence, this Court has recorded its findings on the issue of adulteration as well as issue of exercising the right conferred under Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, therefore, this Court has now become functus officio and cannot hear this case finally and let the case be adjourned.

But, the findings recorded by this Court vide order dated 24.02.2022 are in respect of the suspension application, therefore, the submissions made by learned counsel for the petitioner cannot be accepted and are rejected accordingly.
Also heard on I.A. No.3385/2022 which is an application for urgent hearing of the case.

Looking to the short sentence and the wish of the petitioner to hear this case finally, I.A.
No.3385/2022 is allowed.

As prayed, list this case for final hearing on 30.03.2022.
